arguments.prompt:
Create one production-ready native 2D sprite sheet for Adon, selected version Turok 2: Seeds of Evil (1998), Adon mission-guide appearance. Transparent RGBA background, crisp polished detailed pixel-art game sprites, neutral side-view facing RIGHT. Exactly FORTY-EIGHT DIFFERENT complete drawings of this ONE character arranged in exactly EIGHT columns and SIX equally spaced horizontal rows, landscape sheet. No labels, no text, no grid lines, no environment, no other character. Preserve ample transparent separation: every figure, hair, whole weapon and feet must fit independently inside its cell; compact poses, no figure or weapon crosses into another cell. Consistent camera, scale, character design and equipment across all48.
Selected appearance: Adult alien female emissary, pale grey-blue skin, yellow eyes, gold diadem with purple jewel, blue-silver hair pulled back close behind head, engraved golden collar and shoulder pieces, dark plum sleeveless cropped top, visible pale grey-blue midriff, dark plum trousers, gold forearm bracers and shin armour over dark shoes; original Turok2 model, no ivory robe or Turok3 long black hair.
Selected equipment: Empty hands, mission-guide gesture. Action: Guidage de l’émissaire Adon; one non-damaging open-hand communication/support gesture; empty hands stay empty, no strike, ray or projectile.
Each physical row has TWO separate four-pose animation sequences (columns1-4, then columns5-8), so draw these exact twelve sequences in reading order. Each sequence has four visibly different native body/hand/foot poses, never copied duplicates:
ROW1 left: intro readying the selected equipment, settling feet and taking a ready stance. ROW1 right: outro relaxing, lowering equipment and preparing to leave.
ROW2 left: first-round victory, a restrained in-character proud gesture, ready for next round. ROW2 right: first-round defeat, tired but uninjured, brief kneel then recovery; complete visible body.
ROW3 left: final action demonstration using one non-damaging open-hand communication/support gesture; empty hands stay empty, no strike, ray or projectile, no victim, no injury or execution. ROW3 right: final victory, relaxed in-character acknowledgement then calm stance.
ROW4 left: final defeat, slumped uninjured posture and low recovery, entire character visible. ROW4 right: charged super action one non-damaging open-hand communication/support gesture; empty hands stay empty, no strike, ray or projectile, four poses ordered PREPARE / ANTICIPATE / RELEASE / RECOVER. Release pose is THIRD. All equipment remains complete, no huge effects or additional weapons.
ROW5 left: basic idle breathing, four different subtle whole-body poses. ROW5 right: run cycle facing right, four clearly different alternating limb positions with equipment controlled.
ROW6 left: ordinary basic action, four distinct poses PREPARE / ANTICIPATE / RELEASE / RECOVER with third pose releasing one non-damaging open-hand communication/support gesture; empty hands stay empty, no strike, ray or projectile; retain chosen equipment and support nature. ROW6 right: uninjured recoil/hit reaction, four different balanced poses, no blood, no wounds, no damage effects.
Every character is fully clothed/equipped as selected, presented neutrally as a game sprite. All48 drawings must be distinct; this is a generated adaptation of the stated version, not official extracted game frames. Keep all effects small and attached to the selected physical emitter, with the actual emitter visible. Transparent surrounding pixels including all cell margins.
